_comment: Curated New York courses (see .claude/skills/course-research). Built by: node scripts/courses/build-ct-seed.mjs --state NY. No NY bulk file yet, so npm run db:import-courses imports src/data/seed/courses.ny.json directly.

accessSource.name: Ticonderoga Golf Course official site
accessSource.note: Site describes itself as "A Public 18-Hole Golf Course" with daily rates and online tee times

extraSources.name: Ticonderoga Golf Course club history (USGA course & slope ratings, architect, dates)

ticonderoga.note: Not in the cached OpenGolfAPI data; card-only course. Par, men's stroke index and hole yardages from the official scorecard PDF (every nine and total adds up). Ratings from the course's USGA course & slope list on its club-history page, which gives no gender: Blue, White and Gold recorded as men's, Red (67.8/110 at 4,707 yd) as women's. Stymie matches the card's par, men's stroke index and the ratings. GolfPass shows a different stroke index and conflicting ratings and was disregarded. Architect Seymour Dunn; first nine opened 1926, 18 holes 1932 (club history). Location from OpenStreetMap.
